name: Local Server
description: Serve a folder as a website on this computer or your local network and watch every request
help: Choose a folder and a port, then press Start. Open the address in a browser to see the folder as a website; stop the server with Stop.
By default only this computer can connect. Turn on “Allow LAN access” to open the site from a phone or another computer on the same network, for example by scanning the QR code.
index.html is served for folders that contain one; otherwise a file listing is shown when “Directory listing” is on.
“SPA fallback” serves the root index.html for paths without a file extension, which single-page apps with client-side routing need.
Files and folders starting with a dot (such as .git and .env) are hidden unless you turn that option off. Paths can never leave the chosen folder.
The server keeps running when you switch to another tool; it also appears in the task center, where it can be stopped.
